description: Empirical reference values for the Pass 3 two-dimensional proximo-distal x anteroposterior chick wing bud paddle model (AER FGF outgrowth coupled to posterior ZPA Shh). All entries are ordinal / qualitative summaries of the cited experiments; no digitised figure values are claimed. Used by measure_morphoeval() in 1969-wolpert-french-flag-morphogen.py.
organism: Gallus gallus domesticus (chick) wing bud, Hamburger-Hamilton stages 18-28

hh_stage_length_clock_um.note: Linear stage clock used by the script for both the 1D growth-scaling sweep and the 2D paddle: L(HH) = 180 + 48 * (HH - 18) um; approximate proximo-distal bud length, not a measured growth curve.

saunders_1948_summerbell_1974_aer_excisi.claim: Removal of the apical ectodermal ridge (AER) arrests distal outgrowth; the limb is truncated at a proximo-distal level that is progressively more distal the later the stage of excision (stylopod only after early excision, zeugopod after intermediate, autopod after late excision).
saunders_1948_summerbell_1974_aer_excisi.caveat: Ordinal summary of Saunders (1948) and Summerbell (1974); the exact stage at which a given segment first becomes complete varies by about one HH stage between studies and with the amount of ridge removed. The model maps truncation level to segment via the progress-zone trisection of the wild-type length (Summerbell, Lewis & Wolpert 1973).

tickle_1981_graft_dose_response.claim: The digit specified next to an anterior polarizing-region graft advances 2 -> 3 -> 4 as the number of viable polarizing cells (graft strength) increases, so the anteroposterior pattern goes 2-3-4 (wild type) -> 2-2-3-4 -> 3-2-2-3-4 -> 4-3-2-2-3-4 (full mirror duplication), reading anterior to posterior.
tickle_1981_graft_dose_response.caveat: Relative graft strengths 0.10 / 0.35 / 1.0 are model dose levels chosen to span the three response classes; Tickle (1981) reports the response as a function of grafted cell number after gamma-irradiation, not as a morphogen concentration.

laufer_1994_niswander_1994_shh_fgf_feedb.claim: Shh in the ZPA and FGF4 in the posterior AER maintain each other in a positive feedback loop: removal of the AER leads to loss of Shh expression in the ZPA (rescued by an FGF4 bead), and an anterior ZPA graft or Shh bead induces ectopic Fgf4 in the anterior AER.
laufer_1994_niswander_1994_shh_fgf_feedb.wild_type_aer_fgf_posterior_over_anterio: Reference 1.0 is the null (no asymmetry); Fgf4 is restricted to the posterior AER so the empirical ratio is > 1 but no quantitative value is published. The model's FGF variable is Fgf8 (ridge-wide, Crossley 1996) plus the Shh-induced Fgf4 component.
